data.title: Electricity price increase from 1 January 2026
data.summary: Beispiel Energie AG announced on 28 October 2025 that its electricity prices rise on 1 January 2026. Your monthly advance payment goes from €72.00 to €81.00.
data.explanation: Your electricity provider is raising its prices because of higher grid fees and procurement costs. The price per kWh, the base fee and your monthly advance payment (Abschlag) all go up. You may decide to accept the increase or use your special right to cancel (Sonderkündigungsrecht) without a notice period, effective when the change takes effect. The cancellation must be made in text form (Textform), such as an email. The app shows until when you can cancel. If you cancel, arrange a new supplier so you are not moved to basic supply.
